ModMetaData.name: RimLingo Language Pack — 简体中文
ModMetaData.author: Gesvd & Codex
ModMetaData.description:
像普通模组一样安装：将本文件夹放入 RimWorld/Mods，或在创意工坊订阅后，在游戏模组列表同时启用 RimLingo 和本扩展包。基础包已含英文到中文；本扩展添加中文到英文。无需向基础模组复制模型文件。
RimLingo v1.4.0 optional offline language mod. Enable after the base mod. Models are detected automatically; no manual path configuration or file copying is required. Other non-English language pairs may need both endpoint packs and use English as a pivot.
